units.source_text: [\[23\]](#part1330.html#w23) 亲王的等级是一品到四品，四品以下叫作无品亲王。

en.t: [23] The ranks of imperial princes ran from the First Rank to the Fourth Rank, and those below the Fourth Rank were called unranked imperial princes.

units.source_text: 童年封亲王，规定是无品亲王，地位甚低。

en.t: When someone was made an imperial prince in childhood, the rule was that he would be an unranked imperial prince, a very low position.
